features.label: Collar not included
features.text: This product is the Occian Back Jr rear panel attachment only, designed to replace the standard back piece on the Ossur Miami Jr P2 cervical collar, the front support and chin support must be purchased separately.

features.label: Pediatric occipital skin protection
features.text: Intuitech memory foam contours to the shape of a pediatric patient's head and redistributes pressure away from bony prominences to help prevent occipital ulceration during prolonged supine positioning.

features.label: Clinically proven results
features.text: Clinically proven to virtually eliminate occipital breakdown without sacrificing c-spine stability during extended cervical immobilization.

features.label: Transparent to diagnostic imaging
features.text: MR Safe, X-ray lucent, and CT lucent construction allows cervical spine imaging protocols to proceed without collar removal or repositioning.

features.label: Daily cleaning and skin monitoring
features.text: Peel the pad from the shell, wipe both with a damp cloth and mild soap, and air dry, inspect skin beneath the device for breakdown once per shift.

features.label: Caregiver efficiency
features.text: Hook-and-loop attachment allows the back piece to be removed and replaced in seconds for routine skin assessments, wound care, and hygiene without disturbing the anterior collar position.

features.label: Miami jr p2 only
features.text: Compatible exclusively with the Ossur Miami Jr P2 cervical collar, not compatible with Miami J, Miami J Select, or Miami Jr P3 models, verify collar model before ordering.

features.label: Single patient multiple use
features.text: Device is designed for repeated use on one patient, retain the original collar back piece for use when the patient becomes ambulatory.

features.label: Removable foam pad
features.text: Pad peels off the outer shell for separate cleaning, do not machine wash, tumble dry, iron, bleach, or use fabric softener.

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with US-based brace specialists.

indications: Pediatric patients not awake and alert within 24 to 48 hours after admission
Pediatric patients with pre-existing skin injuries or lacerations to the head and neck
Burn patients who must wear a collar
Elective surgery patients desiring nighttime post-operative comfort
Patients who remain in a supine position for long periods related to respiratory, neurological, or haemodynamic instability
measurement: Universal sizing fits the Ossur Miami Jr P2 cervical collar only. No measurement required. Not compatible with Miami J, Miami J Select, or Miami Jr P3 collars (see Occian Back for adult compatibility). For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
